subject: Kickoff: MolDQN lead-optimization pilot
body:
Hi Bao,

Kicking off MolDQN (Apr 20 – Jul 27). Our open-source release frames molecule optimization as an MDP — the definition in chemgraph/mcts/molecules.py — where every action is a chemically valid edit, and a DQN learns to walk molecules toward a property target. The starter task is QED optimization with both naive and bootstrap DQN configs.

Why now: two chemistry partners want interpretable lead optimization where every intermediate structure is valid by construction — that's the trust story this portfolio exists for, and it's a differentiator against black-box generative baselines.

Milestones: mid-May — QED reproduction on both configs; mid-June — partner property targets encoded as reward functions; mid-July — pilot report with a go/no-go on a Q4 engagement.

Known limitation to scope honestly: the MDP doesn't support modifying aromatic bonds or multiple oxidation states, so some partner chemotypes are out of reach. I want that in the pilot agreement, not discovered later.

Staffing + budget by May 8?

Ximena
